python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess
p=subprocess.run(['ioreg','-r','-c','IOSerialBSDClient','-l','-w','0'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
print('IOSERIAL_REGISTRY_BEGIN')
for line in p.stdout.splitlines():
    low=line.lower()
    if any(k in low for k in ('iocalloutdevice','iodialindevice','usb serial','usbserial','wch','ch34','ch910','cp210','espressif','idvendor','idproduct')):
        print(line)
print('IOSERIAL_REGISTRY_END')
print('IOREG_RC',p.returncode)
PY
